sources.title: Francesco-A/code-search-net-tokenizer · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Code Search Net Tokenizer is a custom tokenizer specifically trained for tokenizing Python code snippets. It has been trained on a large corpus of Python code snippets from the CodeSearchNet dataset using the GPT-2 model as a starting point.
